questions.prompt: The Zero Trust security policy requires that every API microservice request _____ mutual TLS certificates before granting access.

explanations.correct: B2 cybersecurity & cloud architecture syntax: Mandative subjunctive after 'requires that' takes base form 'validate'.
explanations.wrong_A: Option 'validates' violates formal mandative subjunctive or inversion rules.
explanations.wrong_C: Option 'shall validate' applies inappropriate indicative or non-inverted phrasing.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'must to validate' is ungrammatical in formal enterprise IT discourse.
